name: Evergreen
description: Local-first deprecation intelligence for software repositories. Finds end-of-life and deprecated runtimes, packages, and GitHub Actions at exact file locations, with authoritative sources and migration context. Runs on your machine as a stdio MCP server; scans never use the network.

skills.name: Scan repository
skills.description: Run all built-in Evergreen detectors against a local repository and return the complete versioned scan result.

skills.name: List deprecations
skills.description: Run a fresh local scan and return a compact, versioned list of lifecycle findings.

skills.name: Explain deprecation
skills.description: Run a fresh local scan and return one complete evidence-backed finding by ID.

skills.name: Create migration context
skills.description: Create a validated, rule-specific migration packet for one finding from a fresh local scan.

skills.name: Verify migration
skills.description: Re-scan locally and check whether a finding observed earlier in this MCP session is gone.

skills.name: Check dependency
skills.description: Check one package against Evergreen's lifecycle rules before adding it. no-data means no rule exists, not that the package is safe.

skills.name: Forecast repository
skills.description: List dated end-of-life events in the next months that affect findings in this repository.

skills.name: Plan migrations
skills.description: Return a migration plan with waves of independent tasks a coordinating agent can hand out.
